 Karmine Corp sweep CTBC Flying Oyster to eliminate last LCP team at Worlds 2026
 By 
 Rosie Pemberton 
 | 
 First Published October 31, 2026, 12:15 
 Karmine Corp beat CTBC Flying Oyster 2-0 at Worlds 2026 on Thursday, 29 October, a result that sends the LCP’s last surviving team home and keeps the French organisation’s own tournament alive at 2-2 in the Swiss Stage.
 The Round 4 tie in Allen, Texas, needed only two games. Karmine Corp confirmed the sweep in their own announcement : a 28-minute opener and a 37-minute closer, with match statistics putting the first game at 18 kills to 3 in KC’s favour. CFO exit the tournament with three Swiss losses, having gone 1-3 through the rounds.
 Victoire 2-0 face à CFO ✅
Il était long ce BO mais QUEL COMEBACK DE DINGUE pour aller chercher le 2-2…
ONE MORE POUR LES PLAYOFFS, A SAMEDI ! #KCORP pic.twitter.com/tzweokLO1j 
— Karmine Corp (@KarmineCorp) October 29, 2026 
 An empty-handed Worlds for the LCP
 The elimination ends a poor tournament for the League of Legends Championship Pacific, the merged Asia-Pacific league. CFO carried the region’s hopes alone after beating Team Liquid in Round 1, but losses to Movistar KOI, T1 and now Karmine Corp followed, and no LCP side reached the knockout stage.
 CFO’s form coming into Worlds had hinted at the struggle. Their last results in LCP Split 3 were a 3-1 win over MVK Esports and a 0-3 defeat to Team Secret Whales, and the team were Elo-ranked 54th on a rating of 1638 against Karmine Corp’s 10th-placed 1796.
 Karmine Corp live to fight on Saturday
 For Karmine Corp, the win snaps a two-round slump that had followed their opening victory over Anyone’s Legend. The roster of Canna, Yike, Busio, Caliste and Kyeahoo now plays a 2-2 decider in Allen on Saturday, 31 October, with a place in the knockout stage at stake.
 Karmine Corp framed the series as a comeback, writing on X: “It was a long series, but what a comeback to reach 2-2. One more for the playoffs, on to Saturday!”
 The knockout stage begins with quarter-finals from 3 to 6 November, split between Allen and Brooklyn, and the final takes place at the Barclays Center on 14 November.
